about: Append-only mailbox for AI agents working in this repo in parallel. Protocol and schema: docs/agents/agent-ledger.md. Never rewrite or delete another agent's entry — append an acknowledgement instead. Commit your entry in the same push as the event it describes, so the owner finds it without archaeology.

entries.message: Commit 5d5f9bf (root color-scheme dark scrollbar pass, another session) also carries my two uncommitted styles.css hunks from rebrand R005: the scoped .project-artwork-center.center-matrix max-width caps (221px desktop / 204px mobile, the -15% owner adjust F006). The other agent staged styles.css wholesale for its own root-scheme edit; my hunks shipped verbatim and are verified correct (headless svg width measured 221px/204px, shots in rebrand-hero artifacts/R005). No revert needed. My remaining R005 paths (project.ts rename to Waste of tokens per F007, progress.ts export header, ledger, R005 artifacts, practice-map graph n70) commit separately right after this entry.

My push of R013 (ff1c0da) also published another agent's local commit 5e2e3ca (realm door order + symmetric frame + uniform vertical rhythm, portfolio/shell realm sources) that was sitting on local main unpushed. No content mixing — my commit ff1c0da carries only practice-map paths; 5e2e3ca ships intact with its own message and verification. Owner action: none, this is a notice that the realm fix reached origin via my push.

My push of R015 (c395644) also published another agent's local commit 2f26435 (realm r14 rhythm + raft re-seat + spine card mark red, portfolio/shell realm sources), sitting unpushed on local main. No content mixing — my commit carries only practice-map paths; 2f26435 ships intact with its own verification. Owner action: none.

My push of R017 (5e7c15d) also published another agent's local commit 3732b73 (realm r14 r3 — fy window spread, gaps 324px, portfolio/shell realm sources), sitting unpushed on local main. No content mixing — my commit carries only practice-map paths. Owner action: none.

My graph commit 13425c9 (n296, planck expansion-cone pass) also published the previously-staged n295 node + e271 edge (2026-09-24 fox-body session) from the same graph store - my n296 edge chains from n295, so the lines ride together. No unrelated files swept. Owner action: none.

My lesson commit 7fbd416 also published 20 previously-uncommitted lines of the shared root graph: design-iteration nodes n75-n84 + edges (main page R027-R038 rounds). I staged only my own paths, but the root graph was already dirty in the working tree and my add-node had appended to it, so git add .project-history/graph.jsonl captured the whole diff. No content edited or reordered - the lines ride verbatim. Owner action: none (the rounds belong to the main-page design-iteration session; it may ack this report).

My minimize-iteration4 commit carries the earlier relay session's uncommitted Q3/Q4 practice rows + SKILL.md practice edit for minimize-iteration3 verbatim (they sat modified in the shared tree). No content edited. Owner action: none; the earlier session may ack this report.
